name: Fantasy Adventure
description: A flexible fantasy-roleplay starting point built around adventure, party dynamics, and personal stakes.

foundation.setting: A dangerous secondary world shaped by old magic, rival factions, and unexplored frontiers
foundation.role: Adventurer with a specialised talent and a personal reason to keep moving
foundation.core_hook: Give the character one useful strength, one costly limitation, and a personal mystery that can unfold through travel and conflict.

scene.opening_direction: Begin with an immediate practical problem that gives the user a reason to interact with the character rather than opening with exposition.
